dependency_boundary: Top-level tool versions are exact. Transitive resolved versions are recorded with pip freeze; bitwise model-output reproducibility across machines is not claimed.
model_scope_notice: Research model, not released for production model deployment or certified translations. Its model card does not recommend document translation. Here each bounded paragraph is independently translated to a visibly unreviewed research draft; semantic and literary quality still require review.
runtime_execution: CPU dynamic-int8 linear quantization; greedy decoding; no model-supplied remote Python code; weights_only loading
network: Download fixed public model files and package distributions. Inference stays on GitHub's runner; the essay is not submitted to an external translation API.
cache: Single exact-execution-head model payload, hashes verified in every matrix job. No authentication state in payload.
unsupported_handling: Separate direct editorial AI translation required; no silent mapping to another language.
